evidence.note: White chaise backrest is lying flat.
Backrest is being raised from the flat position.
Backrest is upright and stable.
User reaches to the still-upright backrest.
Backrest is being lowered.
Chaise is flat again.

events.object_description: White chaise lounge reclining backrest; raised is on and flat is off.

evidence.note: Gas grill's main cooking lid is closed.
User is lifting the lid by its handle.
Cooking lid is fully open.
User grasps the open lid to lower it.
Cooking lid is closed again.

events.object_description: Gas grill main cooking lid; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Lower propane-storage cabinet is closed.
Cabinet door is swinging open, exposing the propane tank.
Cabinet door remains fully open.
Propane compartment and open door remain visible.
User grasps the cabinet-door handle to close it.
Lower cabinet is closed again.

events.object_description: Gas grill lower propane-cabinet door; open is on and closed is off.

evidence.note: Plain metal shelf on the sliding-door side is stowed against the grill.
User reaches to the shelf and its support mechanism.
Plain metal side shelf is extended horizontally.
Shelf is still extended near the end of this episode.
Camera moves to the opposite side as the shelf is apparently stowed, obscuring the exact closure.
The plain shelf no longer projects from the sliding-door side.

events.object_description: Gas grill plain left fold-out side shelf on the sliding-door side; horizontal is on and stowed is off.

evidence.note: Red Vida-labeled shelf on the trellis side is stowed beside the grill.
User reaches for the red-labeled shelf.
User lifts and extends the shelf.
Red-labeled shelf is horizontal and stable.
Shelf remains extended beside the grill.
Shelf becomes difficult to see during the apparent folding action.
No horizontal projection is visible; shelf appears stowed.

events.object_description: Gas grill red Vida-labeled right fold-out side shelf on the trellis side; horizontal is on and stowed is off.

notes: Five distinct localized manipulation episodes are visible. The two side-shelf closures are less directly observed because of strong camera roll and opposite-side occlusion, so their off-frame estimates are lower confidence.
scene_description: An apartment balcony containing a white reclining chaise lounge and a stainless gas grill. After an initial survey, the user adjusts the chaise and then manipulates several separate grill components.
